title: Confirmation Card
description: A confirmation dialog with risk-level-styled buttons. Also supports a live `data_source` pointer (composition target for the retired standalone `plan-review` type — see TASKS/phase-6/02-rebuild-plan-review-as-composition.md) so the frontend can re-fetch live status at render time instead of trusting only `prior_response`.

confirm_label.description: Label for the confirm button. Defaults to Confirm.

cancel_label.description: Label for the cancel button. Defaults to Cancel.

request_changes_label.description: Optional label for a third, non-committal action (e.g. "Request changes"). Only rendered when present. Currently only meaningful when `data_source.kind` is "plan_approval".

data_source.description: Optional live-data-source pointer. When present, the frontend re-fetches live status from this source at render time (rather than trusting only `prior_response`) and routes confirm/cancel through the source's own mutation instead of the generic typed-response POST.

kind.description: The live-data-source kind. "plan_approval" re-fetches the plan via `plan_id` and routes confirm/cancel through the same approve/reject mutation the old standalone `plan-review` envelope used.

plan_id.description: Plan id to re-fetch live and approve/reject. Required when kind="plan_approval".
